sources.title: Example operator locations page
sources.publisher: Independent tuition operator (example only; not the analysis subject)
sources.inspection_summary: Official operator-controlled page listing three branch addresses with per-branch programme lists (H2/H1/A Math/E Math/Secondary 1 Math/etc.) and copyright notice. No systematic-acquisition restriction inspected beyond standard copyright.

feasibility.public_redistribution: not_permitted_full_page_content; factual observations (address, subject, level, observation date) may be recorded and cited

sources.use_limitation: Used only as the worked example of operator-controlled evidence for the 'confirmed' evidence rule, and as one real operator page validated during the pilot if it appears in a selected planning area. Copyright is retained by the operator; only short factual observations are stored, never the full page text.

sources.title: tuitioncentres.sg directory
sources.publisher: Independent third-party directory (not government, not an operator)
sources.inspection_summary: Homepage confirms 1,200+ listed providers, searchable by location/MRT/subject/level. robots.txt directly inspected 2026-09-13: disallows only /wp-admin/, otherwise permits crawling; no explicit scraping/reuse policy in robots.txt. Terms & Conditions directly inspected 2026-09-13: contain no explicit clause addressing automated collection, scraping, systematic extraction, reuse or republication of listing data in either direction (neither an explicit prohibition nor an explicit grant of reuse rights).

feasibility.factual_validation: not_usable_alone; directory evidence alone can support possible at most, never confirmed
feasibility.systematic_acquisition: unclear_permission; not authorised in this pass
feasibility.public_redistribution: not_permitted; retain only URLs and short factual references, never copied page content or bulk listing text

sources.use_limitation: Because systematic-acquisition permission is unclear rather than affirmatively granted, S010 is used only through a bounded manual discovery sample per the pilot's frozen query templates. Every S010-derived candidate must be validated against an operator-controlled page before any evidence status stronger than possible is assigned; if no operator page can be found, the candidate remains possible or unresolved, never confirmed.

sources.title: ACRA corporate-entity collection
sources.publisher: Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority / data.gov.sg
sources.inspection_summary: 27 monthly alphabetic CSV datasets (A-Z plus Others), updated through August 2026, under the Singapore Open Data Licence. Exposes UEN, entity name/status and registered address/SSIC description per the previously verified sample child dataset; does not indicate whether a registered address is an operating teaching location.

feasibility.discovery_only: not_recommended_as_primary_discovery_channel; entity names are not branch addresses

sources.use_limitation: ACRA may corroborate a brand's legal identity/registration status only. A registered ACRA address is never treated as evidence of an operating tuition branch at that address; branch existence requires operator-controlled or, at minimum, directory-plus-validation evidence.

sources.title: General permitted web search (discovery channel, not a registered dataset)
sources.inspection_summary: Used only to locate candidate operator-controlled pages for a planning area/subject query; not a stored dataset.

feasibility.factual_validation: not_usable_alone; must locate and then validate against an operator-controlled page
feasibility.public_redistribution: not_permitted; raw search-result pages and snippets are never persisted, only the resulting operator URL and observation date once validated

sources.use_limitation: A second, distinct discovery channel from S010 for overlap/unique-yield measurement. Search-result snippets are read only to identify a candidate operator URL, then discarded; nothing from the search-results page itself is stored.
